strongest_objection: The map's headline fork is stated as a two-way fork with no third path, and the third path is the commonest real resolution. Queue to hijack says the parasite lives only until the host prices the lot or forbids the trade, and the edge to Memory pinned to the house says there is no path on which the queue and the market both survive. But a host can sell the jump itself and keep the queue as the thing that makes the jump worth paying for: Disney's paid lane beside the free line, priority boarding, express highway lanes, a restaurant selling its own prime slots at a premium while the walk-in line stays. On that path the queue and a market coexist by design, and the good born is exchange-ontologies' Priority rather than the Tuesday table. The fork survives as a three-tined fork, and the sequence still conceals it, but the label's exclusion claim is false and the item's closing clause omits the tine an operator is most likely to choose. Beyond that, the map leans on the voluntary offset market as evidence three times (Delivered absence, Seller's own witness, The clock's side) and in the third use calls it a rumor while in the second claims such markets die rather than thin, which its own 2023 case contradicts; the used-software case is asserted as a market that never formed when it formed exactly where the mechanism predicts; and Door to say no's 'however many sellers it has' fails on bread. I tried to collapse Thick before it rots into The clock's side (they share the fish) and Cut to a lot into Fence at the lot's edge (they share spectrum) and could not; the items are distinct mechanisms and the strange ones are kept strange.

items.item: Thick before it rots: a seller must find a buyer inside the good's shelf life, so the density of arrivals a market needs is set by decay, and the fish auction fixes one hour before dawn to press a day's scattered landings into one crowd; not a headcount but a ratio, arrivals per shelf life, and the fixed hour is the market manufacturing its own thickness out of sparse traffic.
items.why: Tested as my left neighbor against The clock's side (below); it survives. The fixed dawn hour manufacturing thickness from decay is a mechanism, and the ratio (arrivals per shelf life) is the exact claim. Note only that the frozen-tuna auction uses the same dawn hour without decay binding, so the fixed hour is more general than the ratio; that is a limit, not a failure.

items.item: The clock's side: a market stays dormant until some party cannot wait, and which side holds the clock sets which way the price leans, since the fish must sell by noon and the estate by probate, so the buyer takes his time and the price leans down, while the emitter must surrender allowances by April, so the seller takes hers and the price leans up, and the voluntary offset market, where nobody must do anything, thins to a rumor; not demand or supply, which are wishes, but a date.
items.why: Tested as my right neighbor; it survives as a mechanism (which side holds the date sets which way the price leans). But the illustrative dormancy case is the voluntary offset market 'thinning to a rumor', which is (a) the same observation the map already uses as evidence for Delivered absence and Seller's own witness, (b) not a rumor but a market that traded around a billion dollars in 2023, and (c) thin mainly for the witness reason, not the date reason. The ledger's own draft had the honest dormancy case, family art, which no other item uses.
items.repair: The clock's side: a market stays dormant until some party cannot wait, and which side holds the clock sets which way the price leans, since the fish must sell by noon and the estate by probate, so the buyer takes his time and the price leans down, while the emitter must surrender allowances by April, so the seller takes hers and the price leans up, and family art, where no holder must ever sell and no buyer must ever buy, has no side for its price to lean away from and stays in the attic; not demand or supply, which are wishes, but a date.

items.item: Queue to hijack: a good rationed by waiting already has a price in the length of the line, so a market can be born on the queue itself, as reservation resellers priced the tables a restaurant gave away free and made the house the unpaid seller of its own scarcity until New York banned the resale in 2024; adjacent to exchange-ontologies' Priority, which names the good, this names the birth: a market that arrives as a parasite on someone else's rationing and lives only until the host prices the lot or forbids the trade.
items.why: The closing clause names two host moves; there is a third, selling the jump itself, on which the queue survives because the market needs it. This is the same failure as the fork edge and must be fixed in both. The item is also adjacent to clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Queue clock (the line read as a wait, changed by being read) and should say what it adds: the line read as a price.
items.repair: Queue to hijack: a good rationed by waiting already has a price in the length of the line, so a market can be born on the queue itself, as reservation resellers priced the tables a restaurant gave away free and made the house the unpaid seller of its own scarcity until New York banned the resale in 2024; adjacent to exchange-ontologies' Priority, which names the good, and to clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Queue clock, which reads the line as a wait, this reads the line as a price and names the birth: a market that arrives as a parasite on someone else's rationing and lives only until the host prices the lot, sells the jump itself and keeps the queue as what makes the jump worth paying for, or forbids the trade.

items.item: Seller's own witness: a market can be born on a delivery only the seller can attest, as indulgences sold remission in a purgatory no buyer would inspect and offsets are verified by registries the seller pays; the market's life is then exactly the witness's credit, and because every lot shares one witness, doubt in one attestation is doubt in all of them at once, so such markets do not thin, they die together.
items.why: 'Such markets do not thin, they die together' is contradicted by the item's own case: after the 2023 doubt cast on the flagship forest methodology the voluntary offset market lost roughly half its value in a year and kept trading. The correlated-failure mechanism is right and strange (lots fail together, not lot by lot, unlike a lemons market) and the repair keeps it; only the flat 'die' becomes 'shrink all at once'. 'Registries the seller pays' is also loose: the verifiers are auditors the project developer hires, which is the sharper version of the same point. The item is adjacent to witness-architectures' Silence priced as guilt and should say what it adds.
items.repair: Seller's own witness: a market can be born on a delivery only the seller can attest, as indulgences sold remission in a purgatory no buyer would inspect and offsets are verified by auditors the seller hires; the market's life is then exactly the witness's credit, and because every lot shares one witness, doubt in one attestation is doubt in all of them at once, so such markets do not thin lot by lot as a lemons market does but shrink all together, as the offset market did in 2023 when its forest methodology was doubted; adjacent to witness-architectures' Silence priced as guilt, which is the rule that makes the accused build an honest instrument, this names what a market inherits when no such rule was written.

items.item: Custody out of the maker's hands: the thing must sit somewhere the seller can release it and the buyer can take it without the maker's consent, and a software seat sits in the vendor's activation database, so even after the European court ruled resale of used licenses lawful the used-seat market stayed a rumor because the vendor holds the only shelf; not title, which the buyer may have, but the shelf, and a shelf held by the party who prefers no market is no shelf.
items.why: 'The used-seat market stayed a rumor' is asserted as history and is false: after the 2012 ruling a used market in perpetual volume licenses did form in Germany and elsewhere, through several dealers, because those licenses transfer by document. It never formed for activation-bound or subscription seats. The corrected case is a better illustration of the mechanism than the false one, since the market formed exactly where the shelf was paper and not where the vendor held it.
items.repair: Custody out of the maker's hands: the thing must sit somewhere the seller can release it and the buyer can take it without the maker's consent, and a software seat sits in the vendor's activation database, so even after the European court ruled resale of used licenses lawful a used market formed only for the paper licenses that transfer by document and never for the seats the vendor must switch on, because the vendor holds the only shelf; not title, which the buyer may have, but the shelf, and a shelf held by the party who prefers no market is no shelf.

items.item: Comps: a new price can be judged only against remembered ones, so a house with no comparable sales cannot be mortgaged and the first lot of any new kind trades on a price imported from a neighboring market or an appraiser; the memory is the one precondition the market makes for itself, but only from its second trade onward, and a memory seeded with wash trades records prices that were never paid.
items.why: 'A house with no comparable sales cannot be mortgaged' is overstated as fact; lenders appraise unique houses by cost or income and lend on the appraisal, which is the very route the item's next clause names. One clause changes; the loop and the wash-trade failure mode stand.
items.repair: Comps: a new price can be judged only against remembered ones, so a house with no comparable sales is mortgaged, if at all, on an appraiser's guess, and the first lot of any new kind trades on a price imported from a neighboring market or an appraiser; the memory is the one precondition the market makes for itself, but only from its second trade onward, and a memory seeded with wash trades records prices that were never paid.

items.item: Door to say no: a price is a price only if either party could have walked, so the ambulance ride has no market and its price is a levy, and a tow from the roadside is priced by statute for the same reason; not monopoly, which still lets the buyer go without, but urgency that removes going without, and a market missing this door is a toll booth however many sellers it has.
items.why: The discriminator defines the door as going without the good and then claims a market missing it is a toll booth however many sellers it has. Bread refutes that: nobody can go without eating, yet bread has a market, because the buyer can walk from this seller to the next. The door is two doors, to another counterparty and to going without; monopoly shuts one, need shuts the other, and only urgency that shuts both at once (no time to reach a second seller, no option to refuse) makes the ambulance a levy. This is a sharpening the counterexample forces, not a domestication: the ambulance and the tow keep their place and the claim becomes exact.
items.repair: Door to say no: a price is a price only if either party could have walked from this trade, to another counterparty or to going without, so the ambulance ride has no market and its price is a levy, and a tow from the roadside is priced by statute for the same reason; monopoly shuts the door to another seller and leaves going without, need shuts going without and leaves the walk to another seller, which is why bread has a market though nobody can go without eating, and only urgency that shuts both doors at once makes a toll booth of the trade, however many sellers exist beyond the next ten minutes.

items.item: Money barred: when the community forbids cash as the medium, by a warden or by repugnance, the market is born in whatever substitute the parties can hold, and the substitute's properties then govern it, as prisoners settle in mackerel pouches and once settled in cigarettes that were smoked, so the money supply shrank with use, while kidney donors forbidden to sell trade in chains of paired donations whose marketplace is a matching algorithm rather than a price; not a settlement failure but a bar on the medium, which a market can route around.
items.why: The two cases route around the bar differently and the item hides it: mackerel is a substitute money, so a price survives and the substitute's supply governs it; a kidney chain is a matching algorithm, so the trade survives but no price does. Under the map's own type ('priced and traded at all') that is the difference between a market born whole and a market born without its price, and it is what makes the passage to Price-proof good exact: a bar on the medium can cost the price and keep the trade, a bar inside the good costs the trade itself.
items.repair: Money barred: when the community forbids cash as the medium, by a warden or by repugnance, the market is born in whatever substitute the parties can hold, and the substitute's properties then govern it, as prisoners settle in mackerel pouches and once settled in cigarettes that were smoked, so the money supply shrank with use, while kidney donors forbidden to sell trade in chains of paired donations whose marketplace is a matching algorithm rather than a price; not a settlement failure but a bar on the medium, which a market can route around at a cost the substitute sets: a smoked money loses its supply, and a matching algorithm keeps the trade but loses the price.

items.item: Price-proof good: some goods are changed by being paid for, so the priced thing is a different thing, and an apology bought is not an apology, a bought review is an advertisement, a bought vote no longer says what the voter thinks; there is no market for apologies not because a unit, a witness, or a medium is missing but because the good carries its own motive, and this is the one precondition nothing built can supply.
items.why: The closing clause asserts flatly that this is the one precondition nothing built can supply, while the wild priority two fields away says the boundary is probably not fixed and proposes the apology bond to test it. The mechanism (a good that carries its own motive) is the map's best strange member and stays; only the modality of the universal claim is made visible, in five words.
items.repair: Price-proof good: some goods are changed by being paid for, so the priced thing is a different thing, and an apology bought is not an apology, a bought review is an advertisement, a bought vote no longer says what the voter thinks; there is no market for apologies not because a unit, a witness, or a medium is missing but because the good carries its own motive, and this is, as far as this map can see, the one precondition nothing built can supply.

neighbor_test.left: Thick before it rots: a seller must find a buyer inside the good's shelf life, so the density of arrivals a market needs is set by decay, and the fish auction fixes one hour before dawn to press a day's scattered landings into one crowd; not a headcount but a ratio, arrivals per shelf life, and the fixed hour is the market manufacturing its own thickness out of sparse traffic.
neighbor_test.right: The clock's side: a market stays dormant until some party cannot wait, and which side holds the clock sets which way the price leans, since the fish must sell by noon and the estate by probate, so the buyer takes his time and the price leans down, while the emitter must surrender allowances by April, so the seller takes hers and the price leans up, and the voluntary offset market, where nobody must do anything, thins to a rumor; not demand or supply, which are wishes, but a date.
neighbor_test.separating_case: Both are born from the fish rotting, and the author's pair (Delivered absence, Seller's own witness) is already tested, so I tried these. A probate estate sale in a small town with one bidder: the executor must sell by a date, so the clock's side is present and the price leans down, but nobody manufactured a crowd, so thickness is absent and what happens is a fire sale, not a market. An art fair weekend: the fair manufactures thickness by fixing the hour, so every buyer is in one hall, but no holder must sell and no buyer must buy, so prices hold and half the booths go home with their stock. Thick before it rots names how many must arrive inside the window; The clock's side names who must act before the window shuts. Fish has both, the estate has only the clock, the fair has only the crowd, and the two combinations teach different things (a fire sale versus a fair without trades), so the items do not collapse.

boundary_case: Scarcity, the good must be scarce to carry a price, is tempting because air is free and every market everyone wants seems to want it. It is out for the same reason the author excluded trust: it is not a thing that must be built but the shadow of things that are. Emissions were never scarce until a cap fenced them and a surrender date brought the buyer, so carbon's scarcity decomposes into Fence at the lot's edge plus The clock's side; reservations were never scarce to the diner until a queue rationed them, which is Queue to hijack; a dataset is not scarce because Copy that stays. No case of a wanted market lacking scarcity survives without naming one of the items already on the map, so scarcity is ruled a summary, not a member.

seriation.note: The axis has real endpoints (a lot the exchange writes with a pen; a good no pen reaches) and the consequential adjacency Money barred → Price-proof good teaches what the pile could not, that repugnance splits into a routable bar on the medium and an unroutable bar in the good. Two bookkeeping faults for the repairer. First, the of-sentence sorts into four bands (self-made, outside credit, converted, imported) but the axis walks five, ending in the good's own nature, and Price-proof good fits none of the four; the of-sentence should end '... or cannot have it at all'. Second, the ledger and changed_question count Lose only by waste among the three births by conversion, yet it sits in the imported band at position 14, after Copy that stays. The placement is defensible, since the converter must be a legislature rather than any market participant, but the seriation note should say so: it is a conversion the market cannot perform for itself, which is exactly why it walks with the imports. Money barred sits at 17 for the closing adjacency though the market makes its substitute medium for itself; the note admits the walk is authored, so this is acceptable. No adjacency is arbitrary.

edges.why: The label claims there is no third path on which the queue and the market both survive. There is, and it is common: the host sells the jump (paid lanes, priority boarding, the house's own premium slots) and keeps the queue as what gives the jump its value. The fork is real and three-tined, and only its first tine leads to Memory pinned to the house; the sequence still conceals it, so the form inference holds once the label stops excluding the tine.
edges.repair_label: If the parasite market shows the host what its queue was worth, the host has three moves: name the lot and price it itself, which absorbs the parasite by pinning the memory to the table; sell the jump itself, which keeps the queue alive as the thing that gives the jump its price and makes Priority rather than the table the good; or forbid the resale, which kills the market by decree. Only the first path births the Tuesday-table market, and on the second the queue and a market survive together, which is the path the sequence conceals.

edges.why: The antecedent can fail as written: a baseline can also be written by a standard-setter who is neither the seller nor the seller's hire, as when a registry or the UN body publishes one baseline for every lot of a class before any lot exists. That does not rescue the market, since one shared baseline is one shared story and doubt in it is doubt in every lot at once; but the dependency is on shared authorship of the story, not on the seller in particular, and the label should say so.
edges.repair_label: If the good is an absence, its baseline was observed by nobody, so it must be authored, by the seller, by someone the seller pays, or by a standard-setter who wrote one baseline for every lot of the class before any existed; the first two recruit the seller's own witness, and the third only moves the shared story from the witness to the standard, so the correlated shrinkage survives whichever author is chosen.

edges.to_handle: Custody out of the maker's hands
edges.why: The step 'access lives on the maker's shelf' is stated as necessary and is not: a neutral can host the access, which is what a data marketplace or clean room is. The return the edge describes is real and worth keeping; the escape should be named so the antecedent is honest, and the fact that the personal-data market still does not exist with neutral shelves available points the reader back to Cut to a lot rather than to this pair.
edges.repair_label: If the seller keeps a copy, the only way to make a lot that leaves the seller is to sell access rather than the thing, and access lives on whoever hosts it, the maker unless a neutral is paid to hold the shelf; so curing the copy that stays returns as custody in the maker's hands one item over, and the data market that escapes one fails on the other until a third party holds the shelf, which is what a data marketplace is built to be.

edges.why: Holds as an incompatibility at the limit, and must be relabeled only to match the two-door repair of Door to say no: a tightening clock shuts going without first and the walk to another seller second, and the ambulance is where both are shut.
edges.repair_label: If the clock on one side is tightened far enough, the party who must buy by April becomes the party who cannot walk in the next ten minutes, losing first the walk to going without and then the walk to another seller; the date that gave the market its buyer has shut both doors that made it a market, and the ambulance is the allowance auction at the limit of the clock.

edges.why: A real conditional (a wall that does not record, like the broker's head or a board that deletes stale loads, breaks the loop) and the loop is not visible from the sequence, where Thick before it rots sits between them.

A real conditional whose antecedent fails when cash is not barred. It restates the seriation's consequential adjacency, so it is the one edge a sequence nearly shows; with the Money barred repair it gains a sharper reading (the medium bar can cost the price and keep the trade, the good bar costs the trade), which the repairer may fold in but need not.

modality_problems: Custody out of the maker's hands asserts as history that the used-seat market 'stayed a rumor' after the 2012 ruling; a used market in perpetual volume licenses did form, through several dealers, exactly where the license transfers by document. Repaired.

The voluntary offset market is used as evidence three times (Delivered absence, Seller's own witness, The clock's side) and in the third is called a rumor; it traded around a billion dollars in 2023 and its thinness is mainly the witness's problem, not the date's. Repaired by giving The clock's side the ledger's own dormancy case, family art.

Seller's own witness claims such markets 'do not thin, they die together'; its own case shrank by roughly half in 2023 and kept trading. Repaired to 'shrink all together', which keeps the correlated-failure mechanism and drops the false 'die'. 'Registries the seller pays' repaired to 'auditors the seller hires', which is what the verification arrangement is.
Comps asserts that a house with no comparable sales cannot be mortgaged; lenders appraise by cost or income and lend on it, which the item's own next clause acknowledges. Repaired.

Door to say no's 'a toll booth however many sellers it has' is refuted by staple goods, where nobody can go without and a market exists because the buyer can walk to another seller. Repaired to two doors.
The Queue to hijack fork label states 'no third path' as fact; the third path (host sells the jump) exists and is common. Repaired in item and edge.
Price-proof good's closing universal ('nothing built can supply') is asserted flat while the record's own wild priority doubts it. Modality made visible in the item.

Tolerated as declared simplifications: 'no diamond futures market has ever held' (one was listed in India in 2017 and delisted; the claim is true as stated), the methane-to-carbon table at twenty-eight (one of several published factors), and the mackerel and cigarette economies, both documented.
duplication: none. The map does not restate any grown list; its declared adjacencies (witness-architectures' Room for strangers; exchange-ontologies' Priority) are honest. Two adjacencies were undeclared and are folded into repairs: Seller's own witness sits beside witness-architectures' Silence priced as guilt (which supplies the rule this market lacks), and Queue to hijack sits beside clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Queue clock (the line read as a wait versus the line read as a price). passages-between-levels' Order-book alembic is near Offers on one wall and Comps but concerns what a price becomes one level up, not what must exist for it; distinct.
best_unresolved_seed: A party who can be bound. The of-sentence lists 'a party' among its precondition kinds, but every item's parties are already contract-capable; the map never names the precondition that one side of a wanted market be a thing that can bear an obligation. Markets wanted with a side that cannot be bound, future generations in any long-dated carbon or debt trade, a river granted legal personhood, an unincorporated crowd, a protocol before it has a legal wrapper, are born only when a proxy is deputized to stand for that side, and the proxy's incentives then govern the market the way the substitute medium governs Money barred. It is the trading twin of witness-architectures' Deputized injury, and it is where this map's 'imported' band meets the state most directly.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after repairing eight items (four illustrative cases asserted as history or overloaded as evidence, two discriminators that failed a counterexample, one hidden price-versus-trade distinction in Money barred, one modality clause in Price-proof good) and relabeling four edges, including the Queue-to-hijack fork, which has a third tine the map called impossible.
